```c
// AUTO-GENERATED optimized MHA kernel (S=64, D=64, H=4, H_kv=2, causal=0, fp8:e4m3).
void solution(void) {
  // Head-private temporary buffers to allow out-of-order processing
  uint64_t S1_hw_h[ATT_H][ATT_S][ATT_S / 4];
  elem_t P_q_h[ATT_H][ATT_S][ATT_S];
  uint8_t P_scales_h[ATT_H][GROUPS_S][ATT_S];

  for (int kv = 0; kv < ATT_HKV; kv++) {
    int h_start = kv * (ATT_H / ATT_HKV);
    int h_end = (kv + 1) * (ATT_H / ATT_HKV);

    const elem_t *KT_in = KTs[kv];
    const uint8_t *KT_sc = KTss[kv];
    const elem_t *V_in = Vs[kv];
    const uint8_t *V_sc = Vss[kv];

    // ---- Stage 1: Batch Q @ K^T computations for all heads in this kv group ----
    {
      int tiles_I = ATT_S / DIM, tiles_J = ATT_S / DIM, tiles_K = ATT_D / DIM;
      uint32_t a_base = 0;
      uint32_t b_base = BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS - tiles_K * tiles_J * DIM;

      // Load shared KT scales and matrix once
      gemmini_flush(0);
      gemmini_extended3_config_ex(WEIGHT_STATIONARY, 0, 0, ACC_SCALE_IDENTITY, 1, 1, 0, 0, false, 0, 0, 3, 0);
      gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)KT_sc, QSS_BYTES, 1);
      gemmini_config_ld(ATT_S * sizeof(elem_t));
      for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++)
        for (int j = 0; j < tiles_J; j += 2) {
          int bb = (tiles_J - j < 2) ? (tiles_J - j) : 2;
          gemmini_extended_mvin((void *)(((elem_t *)KT_in) + (k * DIM) * ATT_S + j * DIM),
                                b_base + (k * tiles_J + j) * DIM, bb * DIM, DIM);
        }

      // Process each head's Q matrix against the shared K^T
      for (int h = h_start; h < h_end; h++) {
        const elem_t *Q_in = Qs[h];
        const uint8_t *Q_sc = Qss[h];

        gemmini_flush(0);
        gemmini_extended3_config_ex(WEIGHT_STATIONARY, 0, 0, ACC_SCALE_IDENTITY, 1, 1, 0, 0, false, 0, 0, 3, 0);
        gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)Q_sc, QSS_BYTES, 0);

        gemmini_config_ld(ATT_D * sizeof(elem_t));
        for (int i = 0; i < tiles_I; i++)
          for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k += 2) {
            int bb = (tiles_K - k < 2) ? (tiles_K - k) : 2;
            gemmini_extended_mvin((void *)(((elem_t *)Q_in) + i * DIM * ATT_D + k * DIM),
                                  a_base + (i * tiles_K + k) * DIM, bb * DIM, DIM);
          }

        gemmini_config_st(S_OUT_COLS * sizeof(out_t));
        gemmini_mxquant_config_mvout((uint64_t)scale_factors, tiles_I, tiles_J, tiles_K, 0, 0, 1);

        // Use skips=0x38 to avoid redundant B-load (KT already in spad)
        gemmini_loop_ws_spad(tiles_I, tiles_J, tiles_K, 0, 0, 0,
                             a_base, BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS, 0, SPAD_DEST,
                             false, false, false, false, false, NO_ACTIVATION,
                             0, 0, false, 0x38);
        gemmini_mx_read_smem(&S1_hw_h[h][0][0], SPAD_DEST * 16, ATT_S * ATT_S);
        gemmini_fence();
      }
    }

    // ---- Stage 2: Softmax on host for all heads in this kv group ----
    for (int h = h_start; h < h_end; h++) {
      for (int i = 0; i < ATT_S; i++) {
        int64_t q[ATT_S];
        int64_t mq = -((int64_t)1 << 62);
        for (int j = 0; j < ATT_S; j += 4) {
          uint64_t w = S1_hw_h[h][i][j / 4];
          for (int l = 0; l < 4; l++) {
#if ATT_CAUSAL
            if (j + l > i) {
              q[j + l] = -((int64_t)1 << 62);
              continue;
            }
#endif
            int64_t qq = mx_ibf16_to_q((uint16_t)((w >> (l * 16)) & 0xFFFF));
            q[j + l] = qq;
            if (qq > mq) mq = qq;
          }
        }
        int64_t p[ATT_S];
        int64_t sm = 0;
        int64_t gmax_arr[GROUPS_S];
        for (int g = 0; g < GROUPS_S; g++) {
          int64_t gmax = 0;
          for (int j = g * 32; j < (g + 1) * 32; j++) {
            int64_t pv = mx_iexp(q[j] - mq);
            p[j] = pv;
            sm += pv;
            if (pv > gmax) gmax = pv;
          }
          gmax_arr[g] = gmax;
        }
        int ls = mx_ilog2((uint64_t)sm);
        uint64_t inv_sm =
            (((uint64_t)1 << (ls + MX_FRAC)) + ((uint64_t)sm >> 1)) / (uint64_t)sm;
        for (int g = 0; g < GROUPS_S; g++) {
          int64_t gmax = gmax_arr[g];
          if (gmax == 0) {
            P_scales_h[h][g][i] = 0;
            for (int j = g * 32; j < (g + 1) * 32; j++) P_q_h[h][i][j] = 0;
            continue;
          }
          int e = mx_ilog2((uint64_t)gmax) - ls - MX_P_TARGET_LOG2;
          P_scales_h[h][g][i] = (uint8_t)(e + 127);
          for (int j = g * 32; j < (g + 1) * 32; j++)
            P_q_h[h][i][j] = mx_ienc_fp8(p[j], inv_sm, ls, e);
        }
      }
    }

    // ---- Stage 3: Batch P @ V computations for all heads in this kv group ----
    {
      int tiles_I = ATT_S / DIM, tiles_J = ATT_D / DIM, tiles_K = ATT_S / DIM;
      uint32_t a_base = 0;
      uint32_t b_base = BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS - tiles_K * tiles_J * DIM;

      // Load shared V scales and matrix once
      gemmini_flush(0);
      gemmini_extended3_config_ex(WEIGHT_STATIONARY, 0, 0, ACC_SCALE_IDENTITY, 1, 1, 0, 0, false, 0, 0, 3, 0);
      gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)V_sc, VSS_BYTES, 1);
      gemmini_config_ld(ATT_D * sizeof(elem_t));
      for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++)
        for (int j = 0; j < tiles_J; j += 2) {
          int bb = (tiles_J - j < 2) ? (tiles_J - j) : 2;
          gemmini_extended_mvin((void *)(((elem_t *)V_in) + (k * DIM) * ATT_D + j * DIM),
                                b_base + (k * tiles_J + j) * DIM, bb * DIM, DIM);
        }

      // Process each head's P matrix against the shared V
      for (int h = h_start; h < h_end; h++) {
        gemmini_flush(0);
        gemmini_extended3_config_ex(WEIGHT_STATIONARY, 0, 0, ACC_SCALE_IDENTITY, 1, 1, 0, 0, false, 0, 0, 3, 0);
        gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)&P_scales_h[h], sizeof(P_scales_h[h]), 0);

        gemmini_config_ld(ATT_S * sizeof(elem_t));
        for (int i = 0; i < tiles_I; i++)
          for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k += 2) {
            int bb = (tiles_K - k < 2) ? (tiles_K - k) : 2;
            gemmini_extended_mvin((void *)(((elem_t *)P_q_h[h]) + i * DIM * ATT_S + k * DIM),
                                  a_base + (i * tiles_K + k) * DIM, bb * DIM, DIM);
          }

        gemmini_config_st(D_OUT_COLS * sizeof(out_t));
        gemmini_mxquant_config_mvout((uint64_t)scale_factors, tiles_I, tiles_J, tiles_K, 0, 0, 1);

        // Use skips=0x38 to avoid redundant B-load (V already in spad)
        gemmini_loop_ws_spad(tiles_I, tiles_J, tiles_K, 0, 0, 0,
                             a_base, BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS, 0, SPAD_DEST,
                             false, false, false, false, false, NO_ACTIVATION,
                             0, 0, false, 0x38);
        gemmini_mx_read_smem(&O_hw[h][0][0], SPAD_DEST * 16, ATT_S * ATT_D);
        gemmini_fence();
      }
    }
  }
}
```
